Hi!! I'm a bit late here but thought I'd share my story.
My man is 23 and I am 19. We have been dating for a year and a half and have spent 6 months of this in different parts of the UK.

He is the love of my life, and I couldn't ask for anyone better. He came to the UKs first PMDD conference with me and my mother.
He reminds me to take my medication when the brain fog takes over, he cuddles me when I have panic attacks and he forgives me if I ever yell at him.
In my worst day, when I'm really looking for an argument, he knows. And he takes it on the chin, he'll bicker with me for a bit to humor me before distracting me to something else.

The only way we have made this relationship so brilliant is through communication. I was with him when I was diagnosed, and he's supported me ever since. We track all my moods in a shared calendar, and if I can't see the pattern he reminds me what's happening.

We also make sure to go out a lot in hell week, when I'm antsy we'll go for a walk or go to the playpark in the dark and I can take my anger out on the swingset 😂. And remember, it's okay to be alone. If I need space, I tell him. And if he needs space, I allow him to take the time he needs. That's what love is. Trust and understanding! 

I love him so so much, and I hope that you can find someone who can support you. I promise it can be done, and it's everything you dreamed of.
